readings.title: My Classroom
readings.speak: This is my classroom. It is not very big, but it is light and it is clean. The board is on the wall. My desk is next to the window, and the door is behind me. On my desk there is a pen, a ruler and a rubber. My pencil case is under the chair. My friend likes the scissors, but I do not like them!
